summary.text: Oswald Feliz represents the 15th District on the New York City Council, which includes Fordham, Belmont, East Tremont, West Farms and parts of Bedford Park and Mount Hope in the Bronx.
His Council biography describes him as a lifelong Bronx resident and former tenant lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Feliz attended P.S. 46, M.S. 45, Walton High School, Bronx Community College and Lehman College, and earned a law degree from CUNY School of Law, according to his Council biography.

Before joining the Council he worked as a tenant lawyer defending Bronx residents in eviction and landlord harassment cases, including a building-wide case in which tenants received approximately $100,000 in a settlement.
He was also an adjunct professor at Hostos Community College, teaching reading and writing.
